findings.finding: The reason given for two probes is misattributed. Bug a06c's intent rule controls only outbound REMOVEs (ADR 0124: 'emits a REMOVE only for a value in the local ever-seen intent set'). An inbound release is already on the issue, so there is nothing to 'push back'.
